mapper.select: SELECT TOKEN, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, EXPIRATION FROM TB_TOKEN WHERE TOKEN = #{token}
SELECT TOKEN, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, EXPIRATION FROM TB_TOKEN WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY EXPIRATION DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_TOKEN WHERE EXPIRATION < SYSDATE
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_TOKEN T USING ( SELECT #{token} AS TOKEN, #{memberNo} AS MEMBER_NO, #{expiration} AS EXPIRATION FROM DUAL ) S ON (T.MEMBER_NO = S.MEMBER_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.TOKEN = S.TOKEN, T.EXPIRATION = S.EXPIRATION WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TOKEN, MEMBER_NO, EXPIRATION) VALUES (S.TOKEN, S.MEMBER_NO, S.EXPIRATION)
